newsitem.title: USA: Samsonite has new $250 mln credit line.
newsitem.headline: Samsonite has new $250 mln credit line.

text.p: Samsonite Corp said Friday it has a new bank credit agreement with a group of U.S. and European lending institutions for a five-year revolving credit facility of up to $250 million.

The company said the new agreement provides for terms more favorable than the previous agreement, and with more operating flexibility and the ability to borrow in dollars or in several other currencies as its future requirements dictate.
The new credit facility was arranged by BankBoston Securities Inc, and the group of lenders is led by BankBoston NA, as administrative agent.

Generale Bank NV will serve as documentation agent and Credit Lyonnais New York Branch as syndication agent. Bank of America Illinois, Banque Nationale de Paris, and Kredietbank NV shall serve as co-agents under this bank facility.
